title: Bound Mechanic in the dungeon: free her and she moves in
player_outcome: Deep in the dungeon a Bound Mechanic begs for help. Talk to her and choose Free, and she thanks you, leaves, and later moves into town as the Mechanic.
design: Town service 'rescue' {flag, label 'Free', message} in TownServiceSpecs.cs. Handler: TownServices.Rescue(npc, player) sets the flag through Progression.Set and calls TownSystem.UpdateLandmarks at once, so the LeavesWhen departure happens now.
TownNpcDef.DepartMessage (string?, placeholders {name}). Hud's Departed announcement uses it ('{name} has been rescued!').
Landmark residents respect Arrival when it is non-empty (TownSystem.Landmarks.UpdateLandmarks).
game/UI/TownDialog.cs: a Rescue button branch next to the others.
Planner room Mechanic: DungeonPass records the landmark 'dungeon_mechanic' (a floor cell in that room) in LandmarkIds.

Pose: add a 'bound' kneeling pose (hands behind the back) to tools/blender/bgen/human/actions.py and motion.py, and rebuild the mechanic's anim set (build_all.py --anims --only=mechanic). TownRenderer plays 'bound' for defs tagged bound. Until then fall back to idle.
If the NPC phase already delivered a generic bound-NPC system, reuse it and add only the data and the landmark.
data_changes: bound_mechanic: name 'Bound Mechanic', model mechanic, tags [bound], landmark dungeon_mechanic, arrival [flag defeated_skeletron], leavesWhen [flag rescued_mechanic], departMessage 'The Mechanic has been rescued!', service {type rescue, flag rescued_mechanic, label 'Free'}. Lines: 'Help! I've been tied up down here for ages!' and 'Those skeletons took my wrench. Cut me loose?'.
tests: TownTests.BoundMechanicWaitsInTheDungeonAndMovesInOnceFreed: load the landmark; she appears after defeated_skeletron; Rescue sets the flag and she departs; with a valid house the mechanic arrives.
Smoke dungeon.cmds: 'tp landmark dungeon_mechanic', 'wait_until town.bound_mechanic == 1 60', 'town talk bound_mechanic' (or 'ui talk bound_mechanic'), 'assert errors == 0'.
verification: dotnet test; headless dungeon.cmds and town.cmds
risks: Overlaps the NPC phase (audit H: bound Goblin/Mechanic/Wizard/Stylist/Angler/Golfer). Coordinate so that only one rescue system exists.
